properties.introduction: Beautiful native forest and gold-mining relics are the main attractions of the Kaituna Valley. To walk the whole track takes 8-9 hours, or there are shorter walks from 20 minutes to 2 hours.

properties.name: Knuckle Hill Track
properties.introduction: From the top of Knuckle Hill are excellent views of the top of the South Island, particularly Farewell Spit and Whanganui Inlet.

properties.name: Lake Daniell Track
properties.place: Located in Lewis Pass Scenic Reserve
properties.introduction: This is a great walk for families with young children or those people new to tramping. The track is a well formed bench track that can also be completed as a day walk.
properties.alert: Goat control operation in Lewis Forest Park

properties.name: Lake Rotoiti Circuit
properties.distance: 23 km (with river crossing) or 31 km (via swingbridge)
properties.place: Located in Nelson Lakes National Park, St Arnaud area
properties.introduction: Walk around Lake Rotoiti, surrounded by high mountain peaks. It's a great option for families with children and there is the option to catch a water taxi one way or to stay overnight in a hut. This track is part of Te Araroa Trail.
properties.alert: Windfall on Nelson Lakes tracks

properties.name: Leatham Molesworth Route
properties.introduction: This mainly unmarked loop route travels the Leatham Conservation Area and into the magnificent Molesworth Recreation Reserve, traversing mountain tops and tussocky valleys.

properties.name: Leslie-Karamea Track
properties.introduction: The Leslie–Karamea Track is one of the region’s premier semi-wilderness experiences, situated in the middle of Kahurangi National Park.
properties.alert: Cobb Dam Road closure

properties.name: Upper Matiri Valley and 1000 Acre Plateau tramping tracks
properties.introduction: From Lake Matiri you can do tramps to the upper Matiri Valley and 1000 Acre Plateau.

properties.name: Mount Robert Circuit
properties.place: Located in Nelson Lakes National Park, St Arnaud area
properties.introduction:
This loop track around the northern face of Pourangahau/Mount
Robert offers spectacular views over Lake Rotoiti that will keep even kids entertained. It can be enjoyed as a day or overnight walk.

properties.name: Mount Stokes Track
properties.place: Located in Pelorus Sound/Te Hoiere and Kenepuru Sound area
properties.introduction: This tramping track in Kenepuru Sound follows a ridge to the summit (1203 m), the highest point in the Sounds.

properties.name: Tōtara Walk
properties.place: Located in Pelorus Bridge Scenic Reserve
properties.introduction: This easy walking track leads to Tōtara Flat picnic area.

properties.name: Piwakawaka Track
properties.place: Located in Pelorus Sound/Te Hoiere and Kenepuru Sound area
properties.introduction: Piwakawaka Track is easy walking track leading from the northern end of Elaine Bay to a small beach.

properties.name: Rawhiti Cave Track
properties.introduction: Walk to a viewing structure at possibly the most diverse and extensive entrance and twilight-zone flora of any cave in New Zealand.

properties.name: Wakamarina Track
properties.place: Located in Mount Richmond Forest Park
properties.introduction: Follow in the footsteps of old goldminers on the Wakamarina Track to cross the Richmond Range from the Wairau Valley to the Wakamarina Valley.

properties.name: Wangapeka Track
properties.place: Located in Kahurangi National Park, Karamea area
properties.introduction: The Wangapeka route crosses Kahurangi National Park - it crosses two saddles and travels through the beautiful beech-forested valleys.
properties.alert: Limited access to Flora car park up Graham Valley Road

properties.name: Lake Rotoiti (Kerr Bay) walks
properties.place: Located in Nelson Lakes National Park, St Arnaud area
properties.introduction: Explore Kerr Bay on Lake Rotoiti on these short walks and experience the outcomes of the Rotoiti Nature Recovery Project.
properties.alert: Windfall on Nelson Lakes tracks

properties.name: Kōhaihai area short walks
properties.place: Located in Kahurangi National Park, Karamea area
properties.introduction: Enjoy beautiful nīkau forest on these easy walks from Kōhaihai Campsite.

properties.name: Adams Flat Track
properties.place: Located in Kahurangi National Park, Karamea area
properties.introduction: Walk to a replica goldminer's hut and the site of the Adams Creek Workings.

properties.name: Te Waikoropupū Springs Walk
properties.place: Located in Tākaka area, Te Waikoropupū Springs
properties.introduction: View New Zealand's largest freshwater springs and the largest cold water springs in the southern hemisphere, with some of the clearest water ever measured.

properties.name: Johnson Creek Track
properties.introduction: Walk to and through a big slip formed in the 1929 Murchison earthquake.
properties.alert: Predator control operation in Garibaldi-Kakapo

properties.name: Skyline Walk
properties.introduction: Walk up to a viewpoint over Murchison township, and the Matakitaki, Buller and Matiri rivers.

properties.name: Lake Matiri Hut Track
properties.introduction: Walk to Lake Matiri Hut on the shores of Lake Matiri.

properties.name: Mistletoe Bay tracks
properties.place: Located in Queen Charlotte Sound/Tōtaranui area
properties.introduction: Take either the James Vogel Track circular walk or the longer round trip on the Peninsula Track.

properties.name: Red Hills Route
properties.place: Located in Nelson Lakes National Park
properties.introduction: The Red Hills Route is a challenging backcountry adventure from Mid Wairoa Hut by the Wairoa River to Red Hills Hut. This track is part of Te Araroa Trail.

properties.name: Waiuta to Big River Track
properties.introduction: Walk or mountain bike an old benched pack track past old mining sites to Big River Hut.

properties.name: Progress Water Race Track
properties.introduction: Cross the Inangahua suspension bridge to follow this track up stairs and along the old Progress Water Race.

properties.name: Tawa Walk and Weta Walk
properties.place: Located in Pelorus Bridge Scenic Reserve
properties.introduction: Tawa Walk is a gentle wheelchair-friendly walk near the cafe car park to forest and river terraces and Weta Walk is a short 5 min walk.

properties.name: Flora Circuit (via Mt Arthur Hut and Flora Hut)
properties.place: Located in Kahurangi National Park, Mount Arthur area
properties.introduction: Walk through beech forest and alpine scrub to see views over Arthur Range and Tasman Bay.
properties.alert: Limited access to Flora car park up Graham Valley Road

properties.name: Pillar Point Lighthouse Track
properties.place: Located in Farewell Spit Nature Reserve and Pūponga Farm Park
properties.introduction: A walking and mountain biking track to Pillar Point Lighthouse.

properties.name: Lake Rotoroa Nature Walk
properties.place: Located in Nelson Lakes National Park
properties.introduction: A botanist's delight, this short loop takes you through the diverse forest on the shore of Lake Rotoroa.

properties.name: Tōtaranui to Awaroa Bay
properties.place: Located in Abel Tasman National Park
properties.introduction: For a more adventurous day walk, head south from Tōtaranui to Awaroa Bay, crossing the tidal Awaroa inlet. There is the option to return via water taxi.

properties.name: Tōtaranui to Anapai Bay
properties.place: Located in Abel Tasman National Park
properties.introduction: For a great day walk option, follow the Coast Track north to Anapai Bay from Tōtaranui.

properties.name: Hawkes Lookout Walk
properties.place: Located in Kahurangi National Park, Motueka area
properties.introduction: A short walk past rock formations to a lookout with excellent views.
properties.alert: Hawkes Lookout Walk car park temporary closure

properties.name: Kiwi Track
properties.introduction: This old goldminer's track leads to Kiwi Saddle Hut.

properties.name: Tamatahia Te Whenua Track
properties.introduction: Wind through the Globe Progress Mine's former processing plant site and discover its stories through a series of interpretive signs.

properties.name: Parapara Peak
properties.introduction: The track to the summit of Parapara Peak (1249 m) is steep and difficult, and requires fitness and experience.
properties.alert: Predator control in Parapara area of Kahurangi National Park

properties.name: Washbourn Scenic Reserve Walk
properties.introduction: The Washbourn Scenic Reserve is a delightful patch of forest, providing a very easy 15-minute walk.

properties.name: Big River – Golden Lead Battery
properties.introduction: From Big River Hut, follow an old mine ride to Big River Engine House and other historic sites.

properties.name: Abel Tasman Coast Track
properties.place: Located in Abel Tasman National Park
properties.introduction: Enjoy the mild climate, golden beaches and lush coastal native bush on the Abel Tasman Coast Track.
properties.alert: Wilding conifer control in Abel Tasman National Park

properties.name: Antimony Mines Track
properties.place: Located in Queen Charlotte Sound/Tōtaranui area
properties.introduction: The Antimony Mines Track which leads from Endeavour Inlet past the site of an old mine and on to the Titirangi Road.

properties.name: Queen Charlotte Track
properties.place: Located in Queen Charlotte Sound/Tōtaranui area
properties.introduction: Experience the spectacular Marlborough Sounds by walking or biking the Queen Charlotte Track. The track stretches 73.5 km  from historic Meretoto/Ship Cove through to Anakiwa in Queen Charlotte Sound. This track is part of Te Araroa Trail.
properties.alert: Cowshed Bay Campsite temporary closures

properties.name: Wairau Lagoons Walkway
properties.introduction: This flat loop track, ideal for kids, follows the lagoon shoreline with good bird watching to the rusting remains of the Waverley ship.

properties.name: Gibbs Hill Track
properties.place: Located in Abel Tasman National Park
properties.introduction: The Gibbs Hill Track crosses Abel Tasman National Park inland between Wainui and Tōtaranui.

properties.name: Waikakaho/Cullen Creek Track
properties.place: Located in Mount Richmond Forest Park
properties.introduction: This walkway follows an old goldminer's trail across the range between the Wairau Valley and Linkwater. It can be walked or ridden in one day, but you will need to arrange transport between the road ends.

properties.name: Mt Owen tracks and routes
properties.duration: Northern access: 9 hr, Southern access 7 hr
properties.distance: Courthouse Flat to Granity Pass Hut - 8.3 km
properties.introduction: At 1875 m Mt Owen is the highest peak in Kahurangi National Park and on a fine day the views from this peak are spectacular.

properties.name: Motuara Island Lookout Track
properties.place: Located in Motuara Island Scenic Reserve, Queen Charlotte Sound/Tōtaranui area
properties.introduction: Experience stunning views over Queen Charlotte Sound and spot some native birds on this walk up to the island's summit.

properties.name: St James Walkway
properties.place: Located in Lewis Pass Scenic Reserve, St James Conservation Area
properties.introduction: This track passes through pastoral land, beech forest and sub-alpine regions. This track is part of Te Araroa Trail.
properties.alert: Significant slips on St James Walkway

properties.name: Stanley River Route
properties.place: Located in St James Conservation Area
properties.introduction: This marked route links Charlies Saddle to Stanley Vale Hut in the St James Conservation Area.

properties.name: Mt Arthur Hut Walk
properties.place: Located in Kahurangi National Park, Mount Arthur area
properties.introduction: Walk through beech forest to Mt Arthur Hut - a great day walk for families with kids.
properties.alert: Limited access to Flora car park up Graham Valley Road

properties.name: Flora Hut Walk
properties.place: Located in Kahurangi National Park, Mount Arthur area
properties.introduction: Walk through beech forest to Flora Hut - a great day walk for families with kids.
properties.alert: Limited access to Flora car park up Graham Valley Road

properties.name: Gibbs Hill to Whariwharangi Bay Loop Track
properties.place: Located in Abel Tasman National Park
properties.introduction: Starting and finishing at Tōtaranui, this loop track will take you over Gibbs Hill and around the coast from Whariwharangi.

properties.name: Headlands Track
properties.place: Located in Abel Tasman National Park
properties.introduction: There are great views on this walk above Tōtaranui beach.

properties.name: Pukatea Walk
properties.introduction: A short walk starting from the Whites Bay Campsite.

properties.name: Wharariki Beach Track (Archway Islands)
properties.place: Located in Farewell Spit Nature Reserve and Pūponga Farm Park
properties.introduction: This is the most spectacular coastline in the region, with caverns, islands, sand dunes and a long stretch of beach.

properties.name: Golden Fleece Walk
properties.introduction: This short walk  passes through the former Morning Star stamping battery site.

properties.name: Mt Fyffe Forest Walk
properties.place: Located in Ka Whata Tu o Rakihouia Clarence, Kaikōura area
properties.introduction: Listen to forest birds on this short walk through ancient forest.
properties.alert: Mt Fyffe Forest Walk closed

properties.name: Fossil Point Track
properties.place: Located in Farewell Spit Nature Reserve and Pūponga Farm Park
properties.introduction: Walk across the base of Farewell Spit to Fossil Point, where you may see seals and fossils.

properties.name: Trig Lookout Track / Mount Chisolm Track
properties.duration: Trig Lookout - 50 min / Mount Chisolm - 2hr 40 min
properties.distance: Trig Lookout - 1.3 km / Mount Chisolm - 3.5 km
properties.introduction: These tracks offer spectacular views of the surrounding valleys.

properties.name: Larrys Creek Track
properties.introduction: Follow Awarau or Larry River to get to a historic gold mine.
properties.alert: Larry’s Creek Track access being used for logging

properties.name: Globe Hill Track
properties.distance: 11 km to Globe Progress Mine Site
properties.introduction: This track is for both trampers and mountain bikers. It connects the Reefton township with the Globe Progress Mine site.

properties.name: Fossickers Lake Track
properties.introduction: The track loops around the Globe Progress Mine's former tailings storage facility, known as Fossickers Lake.

properties.name: Nardoo Creek Route
properties.place: Located in Nelson Lakes National Park
properties.introduction: This route provides access to Nardoo Hut and remotes tops in the area.

properties.name: Pudding Hill Track
properties.introduction: A 2 hour walk to the summit of Pudding Hill.

properties.name: Lake Peel Track
properties.place: Located in Cobb Valley, Kahurangi National Park
properties.introduction: Walk to Salisbury Lodge via the beautiful Lake Peel. There are several huts along the way and Lake Peel is a good day walk destination.
properties.alert: Cobb Dam Road closure

properties.name: Lake Chalice Hut tracks
properties.duration: 1 hr to hut | 2 hr 30 min loop from hut
properties.distance: 2.6 km to hut | 6.5 km loop from hut
properties.place: Located in Mount Richmond Forest Park
properties.introduction: Explore the area around Lake Chalice, the only lake in Mount Richmond Forest Park - the short, easy walk to the hut is ideal for an overnight tramp with children.

properties.name: Old Man Hut Circuit
properties.place: Located in Mount Richmond Forest Park
properties.introduction: This circuit via Old Man Hut makes a good weekend tramp.

properties.name: Cobb Valley Track
properties.place: Located in Cobb Valley, Kahurangi National Park
properties.introduction: Walk up the valley beside the Cobb River to Fenella Hut. There are several huts along the way and plenty of options for swimming, picnicking and fishing.
properties.alert: Cobb Dam Road closure

properties.name: Mt Richmond routes
properties.place: Located in Mount Richmond Forest Park
properties.introduction: These tracks provide access to Mt Richmond (1760 m) and can be combined for weekend round trip.

properties.name: Cobb Ridge Route
properties.place: Located in Cobb Valley, Kahurangi National Park
properties.introduction: Enjoy views of Cobb Reservoir from this track that runs along the ridge above.
properties.alert: Cobb Dam Road closure

properties.name: Heaphy Track
properties.place: Located in Kahurangi National Park, Karamea area
properties.introduction: Travel through expansive tussock downs, lush forests and nīkau palms to the roaring seas of the West Coast. Mountain bikes are allowed between 1 May and 30 November.
properties.alert: Landslip on Heaphy Track

properties.name: Speargrass Track
properties.place: Located in Nelson Lakes National Park
properties.introduction: For a good family challenge, walk to Speargrass Hut on an intermediate grade track.
properties.alert: Windfall on Nelson Lakes tracks

properties.name: Mount Arthur Summit Route
properties.duration: 3 hr 30 min - 4 hr 30 min one way
properties.place: Located in Kahurangi National Park, Mount Arthur area
properties.introduction: Climb to the top of Mt Arthur (1795 m) for panoramic views.
properties.alert: Limited access to Flora car park up Graham Valley Road

properties.name: Te Puna Wai o Riuwaka/Riuwaka Resurgence
properties.place: Located in Kahurangi National Park, Motueka area
properties.introduction: Walk to the cave and deep, clear pool where the Riuwaka River emerges from the depths of the Tākaka Hill.

properties.name: Patutu Route
properties.introduction: Climb to the summit of Patutu (1162 m) for great views of the coast and the North Island.

properties.name: Lodestone summit
properties.place: Located in Kahurangi National Park, Mount Arthur area
properties.introduction: Climb to the top of Lodestone (1462 m) and enjoy spectacular views of Tasman Bay and the Arthur Range.
properties.alert: Limited access to Flora car park up Graham Valley Road

properties.name: Six Mile Walk
properties.introduction: Explore what remains of the old Six Mile hydro power station.

properties.name: Ōparara Arch
properties.place: Located in Kahurangi National Park, Karamea area
properties.introduction: Explore 35-million-year-old limestone arch and ancient native forests. This is a true lost world experience that is easy, fascinating, and great for kids.
properties.alert: Slip on access road to Ōparara Arches and Basin tracks

properties.name: Maruia Falls Track
properties.introduction: Walk to a waterfall created following the 1929 Murchison earthquake. It's not safe to swim here.

properties.name: Duffy Creek Route
properties.place: Located in Paparoa National Park, Victoria Forest Park
properties.introduction: This is a lovely day walk that is off the beaten track.

properties.name: Angelus Hut via Pinchgut Track and Robert Ridge Route
properties.place: Located in Nelson Lakes National Park
properties.introduction: The most popular route to Angelus Hut in fine weather.

properties.name: Ōparara Basin: Moria Gate and Mirror Tarn Loop
properties.place: Located in Kahurangi National Park, Karamea area
properties.introduction: Enjoy a beautiful limestone arch and spectacular rainforest reflections on a short walk that kids will love.
properties.alert: Slip on access road to Ōparara Arches and Basin tracks

properties.name: Fenian Caves Track
properties.place: Located in Kahurangi National Park, Karamea area
properties.introduction: Explore the Fenian Caves, with the option to visit the Fenian Workings.

properties.name: Hacket Track
properties.place: Located in Mount Richmond Forest Park
properties.introduction: A day walk up the Hacket Creek valley to Hacket Hut. This track has been badly damaged – there are many slips, take great care.

properties.name: The Grove Scenic Reserve Walk
properties.introduction: Walk through limestone blocks draped with tentacle-like roots of northern rātā, to a viewpoint over the surrounding area.

properties.name: Angelus Hut via Speargrass Track and Speargrass Creek Route
properties.place: Located in Nelson Lakes National Park
properties.introduction: This route is often used to exit Rotomaninitua/Lake Angelus in bad weather. There are unbridged stream crossings, and muddy sections.

properties.name: Mount Robertson tracks
properties.introduction: Mountain bike or walk through mature and regenerating forest, with the option to visit the Mt Robertson/Tokomaru summit.

properties.name: Pearse Valley Route to Pearse River Resurgence
properties.introduction: Tramp up the Pearse River to the Pearse River Resurgence.
properties.alert: Predator control in Cobb area of Kahurangi National Park

properties.name: Richmond Ranges Te Araroa route
properties.place: Located in Mount Richmond Forest Park
properties.introduction: The Richmond Ranges Te Araroa Track is one of the most challenging parts of Te Araroa. You need advanced backcountry tramping skills and supplies for at least ten days.
properties.alert: Wilding conifer control operation for Motueka Gorge and Red Hills

properties.name: Trig K Track
properties.place: Located in Pelorus Bridge Scenic Reserve
properties.introduction: Superb views of the surrounding countryside reward those who climb to Trig K.

properties.name: Mt Fyffe Hut/Kowhai Saddle Route
properties.place: Located in Ka Whata Tu o Rakihouia Clarence, Kaikōura area
properties.introduction: There are superb views from Mt Fyffe. You can climb or mountain bike the steep track to the summit or go as far as Mt Fyffe Hut.
properties.alert: Kowhai and Hapuku Huts temporary closures for repair work

properties.name: Kowhai-Hapuku Circuit
properties.place: Located in Ka Whata Tu o Rakihouia Clarence, Kaikōura area
properties.introduction: This rugged 2–3 day trip over Kowhai Saddle is a challenging Kaikōura backcountry tramp.
properties.alert: Kowhai and Hapuku Huts temporary closures for repair work

properties.name: Circle Walk and Circle Loop Track
properties.place: Located in Pelorus Bridge Scenic Reserve
properties.introduction: The wheelchair-friendly Circle Walk alongside Te Hoiere/Pelorus River continues as the Circle Loop Track. This track is part of Te Araroa Trail.

properties.name: Hinau Track
properties.place: Located in Ka Whata Tu o Rakihouia Clarence, Kaikōura area
properties.introduction: This family-friendly loop track passes through an unusual forest with a number of hīnau trees.
properties.alert: Limited access to Mt Fyffe car park due to weather damage

properties.name: Elvy Waterfalls Track
properties.place: Located in Pelorus Bridge Scenic Reserve
properties.introduction: This tramping track offers the opportunity to view two picturesque waterfalls, along streams that feed into the Pelorus River.

properties.name: Putanui Point Track
properties.place: Located in Pelorus Sound/Te Hoiere and Kenepuru Sound area
properties.introduction: This walking track in Pelorus Sound is boat access only.

properties.name: Fowlers Pass Track
properties.place: Located in St James Conservation Area
properties.introduction: Fowlers Pass (1296 m) connects Tophouse Road with Stanley Vale and Lake Guyon huts in the St James Conservation Area.
properties.alert: Tophouse Road washout detour

properties.name: Governors Bay Track
properties.place: Located in Queen Charlotte Sound/Tōtaranui area
properties.introduction: This walking track leads to a wonderful swimming beach from Queen Charlotte Drive.

properties.name: Momorangi Forest Experience Walk
properties.place: Located in Queen Charlotte Sound/Tōtaranui area
properties.introduction: This is a short loop walk through regenerating forest. Take some time to enjoy the interpretation panels.
properties.alert: Momorangi Forest Experience Walk closure

properties.name: Kumutoto Bay Track
properties.place: Located in Queen Charlotte Sound/Tōtaranui area
properties.introduction: This is a short walk in inner Queen Charlotte Sound.

properties.name: Paines Ford Tramline Track
properties.introduction: Walk to some excellent swimming holes on a track that follows an old tramline.

properties.name: Snowdens Bush Walk
properties.introduction: Snowdens Bush is a popular picnic and recreation area.

properties.name: Archer Track
properties.place: Located in Pelorus Sound/Te Hoiere and Kenepuru Sound area
properties.introduction: This walking and mountain biking track passes through native and pine forest from Penzance Bay to Elaine Bay.

properties.name: Kaihoka Lakes Walk
properties.place: Located in Kaihoka Lakes Scenic Reserve
properties.introduction: This 10 minute walk begins beside one lake and heads gently down to the other.

properties.name: Pupu Hydro Walkway
properties.introduction: Retracing an old gold-mining water race, this short walk passes through forest of young beech and rimu to mature podocarps - it's good for children but be sure to supervise them.

properties.name: Opouri Bridle Track
properties.place: Located in Pelorus Sound/Te Hoiere and Kenepuru Sound area
properties.introduction: Walk or mountain bike through native forest and farmland from Opouri Saddle down to Harvey Bay (Duncan Bay).

properties.name: Forks/Riverside Walk
properties.place: Located in Mount Richmond Forest Park
properties.introduction: Forks/Riverside Walk is in Top Valley, a popular recreational area with swimming holes and picnic and camping areas.

properties.name: Salisbury Track
properties.introduction: Walk to Salisbury Lodge from Flora car park. This is an easy overnight tramp that's good for older children.
properties.alert: Limited access to Flora car park up Graham Valley Road

properties.name: Kawatiri Historic Railway Walk
properties.introduction: This easy walk follows a short section of the former railway line that ran from Nelson towards Murchison.

properties.name: Anatoki and Historic Kill Devil Pack Tracks
properties.introduction: Explore beautiful beech forest, dramatic gorge scenery and rock debris dam at Lake Stanley. Trampers can also enjoy a historic hut experience in restored character huts from 1930s gold mining days.
properties.alert: Predator control in Parapara area of Kahurangi National Park

properties.name: Pūponga Farm Track / Green Hills Route
properties.place: Located in Farewell Spit Nature Reserve and Pūponga Farm Park
properties.introduction: Superb farmland, lakes, cliffs and wind-carved moorlands are features of this track.

properties.name: Nydia Track
properties.place: Located in Pelorus Sound/Te Hoiere and Kenepuru Sound area
properties.introduction: The 27 km Nydia Track offers walkers and cyclists great views and varied track conditions. Plan on an overnight stop at Nydia Bay where you can explore the history and coastline.

properties.name: Chummies Track
properties.introduction: Chummies Track is a steep climb up to John Reid Hut. It fords the Wangapeka River which is impassable if running high.

properties.name: Cullen Point tracks
properties.place: Located in Pelorus Sound/Te Hoiere and Kenepuru Sound area
properties.introduction: Walk the beautiful loop track for views of Pelorus Sound and Havelock and the short lookout track for views of Mahau Sound.

properties.name: Ōparara Basin: Box Canyon and Crazy Paving Caves
properties.place: Located in Kahurangi National Park, Karamea area
properties.introduction: Explore Box Canyon Cave in the Ōparara Basin – kids will love it. Crazy Paving Cave is closed.
properties.alert: Slip on access road to Ōparara Arches and Basin tracks

properties.name: Ōparara Valley Track
properties.place: Located in Kahurangi National Park, Karamea area
properties.introduction: Extend the Moria Gate Loop short walk and experience ancient native forest on a longer walk.
properties.alert: Slip on access road to Ōparara Arches and Basin tracks

properties.name: Cloustons Mine Track
properties.place: Located in Kahurangi National Park, Mount Arthur area
properties.introduction: Walk this track as part of a day walk circuit from Flora car park.
properties.alert: Limited access to Flora car park up Graham Valley Road

properties.name: Chalice–Goulter Track
properties.place: Located in Mount Richmond Forest Park
properties.introduction: Follow the Goulter River from Lake Chalice.

properties.name: Tableland Circuit
properties.place: Located in Kahurangi National Park, Mount Arthur area
properties.introduction: Rock shelters, an open tussock plateau and tops with superb views combine to make this an interesting overnight tramp.
properties.alert: Cobb Dam Road closure

properties.name: Mt Fishtail Route
properties.place: Located in Mount Richmond Forest Park
properties.introduction: Climb up to Mt Fishtail (1643 m) via Fishtail Hut.

properties.name: Mt Patriarch Route
properties.place: Located in Mount Richmond Forest Park
properties.introduction: Walk or mountain bike up Mt Patriarch (1,656 m).

properties.name: Quartz Creek/Mount Royal Route
properties.place: Located in Mount Richmond Forest Park
properties.introduction: Climb up to the summit of Mount Royal (1366 m).

properties.name: Big Rimu Walk
properties.place: Located in Kahurangi National Park, Karamea area
properties.introduction: Walk to a spectacular rimu tree, 36 m high and 2 m in diameter, near Karamea.

properties.name: Lake Hanlon Track
properties.place: Located in Kahurangi National Park, Karamea area
properties.introduction: Walk to this scenic gem from the main road, south of Karamea.

properties.name: Sylvester Hut Track
properties.place: Located in Cobb Valley, Kahurangi National Park
properties.introduction: Walk up to Sylvester Hut as day walk or overnight tramp with children - enjoy great views from the hut and explore a series of lakes on the open tops behind the hut.
properties.alert: Predator control in Cobb area of Kahurangi National Park

properties.name: Eves Valley Walk
properties.introduction: This walking track leads through a rare area of lowland valley floor forest.

properties.name: Union Creek Track
properties.introduction: Visit Union Creek rock stack. A landform that consists of excess rock from mining operations. It's contoured and planted with native vegetation to mimic the surrounding landscape.

properties.name: Croesus Battery
properties.place: Located in Lyell area, Westport area
properties.introduction: Long after its gold mines closed and the last hotel burned down, Lyell retains many reminders of a rich past which can be seen while exploring the surrounding area.

properties.name: Alborns Walk
properties.introduction: Walk through old mine workings on this well-graded loop track.

properties.name: Braeburn Walk
properties.place: Located in Nelson Lakes National Park
properties.introduction: Walk to a mossy waterfall through diverse beech and podocarp forest near Lake Rotoroa.

properties.name: Wainui Falls Track
properties.place: Located in Abel Tasman National Park
properties.introduction: A short walk through lush native bush leads to the cascading Wainui Falls, the largest and most accessible falls in Golden Bay/Mohua.

properties.name: Lankey Creek Tram Track
properties.duration: 2 hr to join with Murray Creek Track
properties.introduction: Walk on an old tram line to an enchanted forest.
properties.alert: Lankey Creek Tram Track partially closed

properties.name: Charming Creek North Walkway
properties.introduction: Walk along the upper part of an historic bush tramway to historic mining sites, milling sites, and to a view of the Mangatini Falls.

properties.name: Lake Rotoiti (West Bay) walks
properties.place: Located in Nelson Lakes National Park, St Arnaud area
properties.introduction: Explore West Bay on Lake Rotoiti on these short walks.

properties.name: Okiwi Bay Lookout Walk
properties.introduction: Enjoy views of the Kaikōura coastline.

properties.name: Black Jack Track
properties.introduction: A loop track in Pukatea/Whites Bay with views of Cook Strait.

properties.name: Pukatea Walk
properties.place: Located in Abel Tasman National Park
properties.introduction: A short walk from Tōtaranui that takes you into magnificent pukatea forest with glades of tall nīkau palms.

properties.name: Flower Brothers Walk
properties.place: Located in Nelson Lakes National Park
properties.introduction: From Lake Rotoroa car park, this track passes through a stand of kahikatea and around the lake outlet emerging on the road near Lake Rotoroa Lodge.

properties.name: Okiwi Bay Seaward Valley Track
properties.introduction: Walk or mountain bike through varied vegetation and enjoy ocean views.

properties.name: Angelus Hut tracks and routes
properties.place: Located in Nelson Lakes National Park
properties.introduction: Angelus Hut at 1,650 metres, sits on the shores of Lake Angelus surrounded by spectacular mountain views. From May to October in most years, the lake is frozen, snow blankets all four routes, and you may have to dig your way to the hut.
properties.alert: Damaged foot-bridge south of Cascade Track

properties.name: Pūponga Hilltop Walk
properties.place: Located in Farewell Spit Nature Reserve and Pūponga Farm Park
properties.introduction: A day walk with fantastic coastal views. Ending at the beautiful Wharariki Beach, the track travels past the Pillar Point Lighthouse and Cape Farewell.

properties.name: Travers-Sabine Circuit
properties.place: Located in Nelson Lakes National Park, St Arnaud area
properties.introduction: Experience tranquil beech forests, fields of waving tussocks, 2000‑m‑high mountains, and clear rushing streams in the heart of the mountains of Nelson Lakes National Park. This track is part of Te Araroa Trail.
properties.alert: Damaged foot-bridge south of Cascade Track

properties.name: Reefton - Big River 4WD road
properties.duration: 3–4 hr driving / 7–8 hr walking one way
properties.introduction: This track through beech forest and mining sites is only suitable for walkers or experienced mountain bikers and four-wheel drivers.

properties.name: Angelus Hut via Travers and Cascade Track/Route
properties.place: Located in Nelson Lakes National Park
properties.introduction: Continue on from Lakehead or Coldwater Hut to Cascade Track, and on to Angelus Hut following the  Hukere Stream.
properties.alert: Damaged foot-bridge south of Cascade Track

properties.name: Inland Track
properties.place: Located in Abel Tasman National Park
properties.introduction: Inland Track travels through regenerating and undisturbed forest where tui, bellbirds and other wildlife can be seen. Occasional granite outcrops offer excellent views of the coast.

properties.name: Angelus Hut via Mt Cedric Track/Route
properties.place: Located in Nelson Lakes National Park
properties.introduction: Continue from Sabine Hut to Angelus Hut on a very steep route.

properties.name: Kirwans Track
properties.introduction: The walk up to Kirwans Hut via Montgomerie Hut is a stunning overnight tramp. There are incredible historic relics to be seen in this area.
properties.alert: Kirwans Track severe damage

properties.name: Klondyke Valley Track
properties.introduction: This route leads  up the valley to a tussock basin enclosed by steep granite cliffs.

properties.name: Lake Stream Route
properties.place: Located in Paparoa National Park, Victoria Forest Park
properties.introduction: Tramp for half a day to arrive at a quaint 2 bunk hut.

properties.name: Mount Haast Route
properties.introduction: This is the fastest way to the bush line from Reefton.

properties.name: Klondyke Spur Track
properties.introduction: A steep climb for experienced trampers that leads to a ridge overlooking the Victoria Range.

properties.name: Murray Creek Track
properties.introduction: Walk or mountain bike this loop walk through beech forest and historic goldfields.

properties.name: Tōtaranui to Waiharakeke Bay
properties.duration: 1 hr 40 min return via the same track
properties.place: Located in Abel Tasman National Park
properties.introduction: Walk south from Tōtaranui past the beautiful Goat Bay to Waiharakeke.

properties.name: St Arnaud to Boyle Te Araroa Route
properties.place: Located in Nelson Lakes National Park, St James Conservation Area
properties.introduction: This challenging route leads from St Arnaud to Boyle Village, traversing Poukirikiri/Travers Saddle, Waiau Pass and Anne Saddle. It is part of Te Araroa.

properties.name: Alpine Route
properties.place: Located in Mount Richmond Forest Park
properties.introduction: This challenging trip above the bushline in Mt Richmond Forest Park offers outstanding views over the Waimea Plains and the Inland Kaikoura Ranges. This track is part of Te Araroa Trail.
properties.alert: Wilding conifer control operation for Motueka Gorge and Red Hills

properties.name: Pelorus Track
properties.place: Located in Mount Richmond Forest Park
properties.introduction: The Pelorus Track offers walkers 3-4 days of hard tramping through forest along the river. This track is part of Te Araroa Trail.

properties.name: Cable Bay Walkway
properties.introduction: Enjoy the coastal views on this walkway between Rotokura/Cable Bay and The Glen, near Nelson. Boating, sea kayaking, and snorkeling are all possible.
properties.alert: Cable Bay Walkway closed for lambing

properties.name: Ōruawairua Track
properties.place: Located in Blumine Island Scenic Reserve
properties.introduction: Experience the stunning views, native wildlife and history on Blumine Island/Ōruawairua.

properties.name: Whisky Falls
properties.place: Located in Nelson Lakes National Park, St Arnaud area
properties.introduction: Walk to these 40 m falls surrounded by thick walls of moss and ferns.

properties.name: Douglas Range
properties.introduction: The route links the Aorere and Cobb valleys in Golden Bay. It is unmarked and suitable for trampers with a high degree of fitness and off-track experience.
properties.alert: Predator control in Parapara area of Kahurangi National Park

properties.name: Mt Sunday/Mt Riley Track
properties.place: Located in Mount Richmond Forest Park
properties.introduction: Pass over Mt Sunday (1310 m) and Mt Riley (1314 m) on this circuit track.

properties.name: Waitahu - Murray Connecting Track
properties.introduction: This historic pack track links Murray Creek with Waitahu valley. It's part of a popular mountain biking circuit.

properties.name: St Arnaud Range Track
properties.place: Located in Nelson Lakes National Park, St Arnaud area
properties.introduction: Climb onto the St Arnaud Range for spectacular views of the surrounding area.

properties.name: The Old Ghost Road
properties.place: Located in Lyell area, Mōkihinui River area,Westport area
properties.introduction: This old gold miners' road is being revived as a tramping and mountain biking track. It traverses native forests, tussock tops, river flats and valleys with stunning views of the magnificent Mōkihinui Gorge and surrounds.

properties.name: Rarangi–Whites Bay Track
properties.introduction: A one-way tramping track between Pukatea/Whites Bay and Rārangi that passes through a pine plantation.

properties.name: Farewell Spit Walk
properties.place: Located in Farewell Spit Nature Reserve and Pūponga Farm Park
properties.introduction: Walk around the base of Farewell Spit, New Zealand’s longest sand spit.

properties.name: Molesworth Homestead Lookout Track
properties.introduction: This short walk, accessible from the Acheron Road, starts from historic Molesworth Cob Cottage.

properties.name: Monkey Bay Walk
properties.introduction: A short walk from Rārangi Beach to the small beach at Monkey Bay.

properties.name: Waiau Pass Route (Blue Lake Route to Lewis Pass)
properties.place: Located in Lewis Pass Scenic Reserve, St James Conservation Area
properties.introduction: Waiau Pass Route is a very technical alpine crossing, suitable for highly experienced parties only. It links Lewis Pass and Nelson Lakes National Park. This track is part of Te Araroa Trail.

properties.name: Pukaka Valley Track
properties.introduction: This forested valley is part of Mt Robertson Scenic Reserve and provides good tramping and hunting opportunities and gives alternative access to the Mount Robertson loop and summit tracks.

properties.name: Mount Augarde Track
properties.introduction: Climb to the summit of Mount Augarde for views north across Isolated Flat and the distant tops of the Severn, Saxton and Acheron Ranges.
